episodes.title: Ein neuer Anfang
episodes.summary: Samira moves her family into a 1970s smart home. Her curiosity turns into suspicion when her son reactivates the house's long-dormant AI assistant.

episodes.title: Wer bin ich?
episodes.summary: Cassandra begins to turn Samira's family against her. Fynn takes an interest in a classmate. In 1971, a woman suspects her husband of infidelity.

episodes.title: Endspiel
episodes.summary: Feeling isolated, Samira tries to convince David of Cassandra's intentions. In 1971, a mother goes to extreme lengths to protect her son.

episodes.title: Ein Kinderspiel
episodes.summary: Fynn goes looking for Steve. Tensions reach a boiling point during Juno's playdate. In 1964, a medical experiment takes a terrible turn.

episodes.title: Du bist nicht allein
episodes.summary: With Samira out of the house, Cassandra takes her family hostage. In 1972, Cassandra adapts to her new living circumstances.

episodes.title: Frohe Weihnachten
episodes.summary: Convinced that her family is in danger, Samira attempts to return home. Meanwhile, Cassandra asserts full control over the house.
